ns2:course.label: Dams, Embankments, and Slopes
ns2:course.description: Fundamentals of static and seismic slope stability and shear strength; seepage in composite sections and anisotropic materials; methods of stability analyses; mechanism of failure of natural and man-made slopes; compaction; field observations. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: CEE 483 - Applied Soil Mechanics.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: CEE 483 - Applied Soil Mechanics.
